questions.question_en: A 38-year-old man presents with 11 g of protein in a 24-hour urine collection and a serum albumin of 1.9 g/dL. The physician warns him about an important complication and tells him to seek care immediately if he develops sudden flank pain. Which complication is most associated with this patient's condition? - A) Renal vein thrombosis ✅ - B) Papillary necrosis - C) Renal cortical infarction - D) Renal artery embolism

questions.question_en: A 65-year-old man was treated for pneumonia with a new antibiotic. Ten days later he presents with rising serum creatinine, fever, skin rash, and eosinophilia. Urinalysis shows pyuria but urine culture is negative. What is the most appropriate initial action? - A) Immediate dialysis - B) Discontinue the suspected drug ✅ - C) Treatment with cyclophosphamide - D) Perform plasmapheresis

questions.explanation_en: Acute interstitial nephritis (AIN) is an immune inflammatory reaction (often delayed hypersensitivity) in the renal interstitium and is a common cause of drug-induced acute kidney injury (AKI). The most common causes: drugs (beta-lactams and other antibiotics, NSAIDs, proton pump inhibitors/PPIs, and recently immune checkpoint inhibitors), infections, and autoimmune diseases (e.g., sarcoidosis and TINU syndrome). The classic clinical presentation: a rise in creatinine days to weeks after starting the offending drug, with the triad of fever, skin rash, and eosinophilia; however, the full triad is seen in only a minority of patients. What is the most likely diagnosis? - A) Hypertensive nephrosclerosis - B) Renal artery stenosis ✅ - C) Aortic dissection - D) Renal vein thrombosis

questions.explanation_en: Renal artery stenosis (RAS) is narrowing of the renal artery that, by reducing renal perfusion, activates the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system and causes renovascular hypertension. Two main causes: (1) atherosclerosis (most common, ~90%; in older patients with vascular risk factors such as diabetes, smoking, hyperlipidemia; usually ostial and proximal involvement); (2) fibromuscular dysplasia (in young women; a 'string of beads' pattern in the mid-distal artery). A key, frequently tested clinical rule: a rise of more than 30% in serum creatinine after starting an ACE inhibitor or ARB is a strong warning sign for bilateral renal artery stenosis (or stenosis in a solitary kidney). questions.explanation_en: Hypomagnesemia (magnesium deficiency) is an important and often overlooked cause of treatment-refractory hypocalcemia. Magnesium is essential for two vital processes in calcium metabolism: (1) secretion of parathyroid hormone (PTH) from the parathyroid glands; (2) target-organ (bone and kidney) response to PTH. Consequently, severe hypomagnesemia simultaneously suppresses PTH secretion (causing a low or inappropriately normal PTH in the presence of hypocalcemia) and induces end-organ resistance to PTH; the result is hypocalcemia that does not respond to calcium administration (even IV) and vitamin D. questions.explanation_fa: هیپوناترمی هیپوولمیک یکی از انواع مهم هیپوناترمی است که در آن هم آب کل بدن و هم سدیم کل بدن کاهش یافتهاند، اما تلفات سدیم بیشتر از آب است. علل شایع: تلفات گوارشی (استفراغ، اسهال طولانی)، تلفات کلیوی (دیورتیکها، بهویژه تیازیدها؛ نارسایی آدرنال)، تلفات پوستی (سوختگی) و از دست دادن به فضای سوم. در تلفات خارجکلیوی مانند اسهال، کلیه بهدرستی سدیم را حفظ میکند (سدیم ادرار <۲۰) و در پاسخ به کاهش حجم، ADH ترشح میشود تا آب را حفظ کند؛ همین ADH بالا باعث دفع ادرار غلیظ (اسمولالیتهٔ بالای ادرار، مثلاً ۵۵۰) و رقیقشدن سدیم پلاسما (هیپوناترمی) میشود. تشخیص با ارزیابی وضعیت حجم (مخاطات خشک، ارتوستاز، BUN/کراتینین بالا با نسبت افزایشیافته) و اسمولالیته و سدیم ادرار انجام میشود. اصل درمان هیپوناترمی هیپوولمی…
questions.explanation_en: Hypovolemic hyponatremia is an important type of hyponatremia in which both total body water and total body sodium are decreased, but sodium loss exceeds water loss. Common causes: gastrointestinal losses (vomiting, prolonged diarrhea), renal losses (diuretics, especially thiazides; adrenal insufficiency), skin losses (burns), and third-spacing. questions.explanation_en: Myeloid sarcoma (also chloroma/granulocytic sarcoma) is an extramedullary tumor mass composed of immature myeloblasts, forming in tissues outside the bone marrow (skin, soft tissue, gingiva, bone, lymph nodes, orbit). It can appear concurrently with acute myeloid leukemia (AML), precede it (as the first manifestation), or arise in the setting of relapse or a myelodysplastic syndrome. Pathologically, the cells are large with scant cytoplasm, a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, and azurophilic granules (sometimes Auer rods), staining with myeloid markers (MPO, CD33, CD13, CD117, lysozyme). questions.question_fa: آ قای ۶۸ ساله با خستگی پیشرونده و پارستزی اندام ها مراجعه می کند. در بررسی آ زمایشگاهی پران سرایتوپنی وآ نمی ماکروسیتیک و الکتات دهیدروسناز باال گزارش می شود. بهترین اقدام تشخیصی کدام است؟ - الف) تصویربرداری مغزی نخاعی - ب) نمونه برداری مغز استخوان - ج) نمونه برداری از معده - د) بررسی ویتامین B12 ✅
questions.question_en: A 68-year-old man presents with progressive fatigue and limb paresthesias. Workup shows pancytopenia, macrocytic anemia and elevated lactate dehydrogenase. What is the best diagnostic action? - A) Brain and spinal imaging - B) Bone marrow biopsy - C) Gastric biopsy - D) Vitamin B12 assessment ✅
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. اگرچه کمبود B12 میتواند دژنراسیون ترکیبی نخاع بدهد، اما تصویربرداری قدم تشخیصی اول نیست؛ ابتدا باید علت متابولیک (B12) را ثابت کرد.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. بیوپسی مغز استخوان تهاجمی است و تنها در صورت رد کمبود B12/فولات یا شک به بدخیمی اولیهٔ مغز استخوان انجام میشود؛ به عنوان قدم اول برای این تصویر کلاسیک منطقی نیست.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. بیوپسی معده ممکن است بعداً برای بررسی گاستریت آتروفیک/آنمی پرنیشیوز کمک کند، اما قدم اول تأیید کمبود B12 است.

صحیح است؛ صحیح. سهگانهٔ آنمی ماکروسیتیک + پانسیتوپنی + LDH بالا (به دلیل اریتروپویز غیرمؤثر و همولیز داخلمغزی) بههمراه علائم عصبی (پارستزی)، بسیار مطرحکنندهٔ کمبود ویتامین B12 است؛ کمهزینهترین و مناسبترین اقدام اول، اندازهگیری سطح B12 است.

B12 برای سنتز DNA (از طریق تبدیل هوموسیستئین به متیونین و متابولیسم متیلمالونیل-CoA) ضروری است؛ کمبود آن باعث اختلال در بلوغ هسته نسبت به سیتوپلاسم و اریتروپویز غیرمؤثر میشود. تظاهرات خونی: آنمی ماکروسیتیک (MCV بالا، اغلب >۱۱۰)، نوتروفیلهای هایپرسگمانته (>۵ لوب)، و در موارد شدید پانسیتوپنی؛ به دلیل تخریب داخلمغزی گلبولهای قرمز نابالغ (اریتروپویز غیرمؤثر)، LDH و بیلیروبین غیرمستقیم بالا میروند (تصویری شبههمولیز). تظاهرات عصبی که ویژگی مهم و افتراقدهنده از کمبود فولات است: پارستزی متقارن اندامها، کاهش حس عمقی و ارتعاش، آتاکسی، و در موارد پ…
questions.explanation_en: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) deficiency is an important, treatable cause of megaloblastic macrocytic anemia that, if diagnosis is delayed, can cause irreversible neurologic damage. B12 is essential for DNA synthesis (via conversion of homocysteine to methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolism); its deficiency impairs nuclear-to-cytoplasmic maturation and causes ineffective erythropoiesis. Hematologic features: macrocytic anemia (high MCV, often >110), hypersegmented neutrophils (>5 lobes), and in severe cases pancytopenia; because of intramedullary destruction of immature red cells (ineffective erythropoiesis), LDH and indirect bilirubin rise (a hemolysis-like picture). questions.question_fa: بیماری با آ نژیودیسپالزی کولون و خونریزی مکرر از رکتوم مراجعه می کند. در بررسی آ زمایشرگاهی آ نمری فقرر آ هن مشهود است. بهترین اقدام درمانی برای تصحیح آ نمی کدام گزینه است؟ - الف) آهن تزریقی ✅ - ب) قرص آهن - ج) آهن خوراکی و اریتروپوتین - د) تزریق خون و اریتروپوتین
questions.question_en: A patient with colonic angiodysplasia and recurrent rectal bleeding presents. Workup shows iron-deficiency anemia. What is the best treatment to correct the anemia? - A) Intravenous iron ✅ - B) Oral iron tablets - C) Oral iron plus erythropoietin - D) Blood transfusion plus erythropoietin
options_why_fa: صحیح است؛ صحیح. در خونریزی مزمن و مکرر گوارشی با فقدان آهن و از دست رفتن مداوم، آهن وریدی مؤثرتر از خوراکی است چون ذخایر را سریعتر و مطمئنتر پر میکند و مشکل جذب/تحمل خوراکی و ادامهٔ خونریزی را دور میزند؛ گزینهٔ ارجح برای اصلاح آنمی فقر آهن در این زمینه است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. آهن خوراکی در خونریزی فعال و مداوم اغلب برای جبران کافی نیست و با عدم تحمل گوارشی و جذب محدود همراه است؛ در فقدان مزمن با تلفات ادامهدار کندتر عمل میکند.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. اریتروپویتین در آنمی فقر آهن بدون نارسایی کلیه اندیکاسیون ندارد و بدون ذخایر آهن کافی اثربخش نیست.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. ترانسفیوژن فقط برای آنمی علامتدار شدید/ناپایداری همودینامیک است، نه اصلاح روتین آنمی فقر آهن؛ افزودن اریتروپویتین هم بی‌مورد است.

questions.explanation_en: Intravenous iron is an effective way to replace iron deficiency when oral iron is insufficient or inappropriate. Main indications for IV iron: (1) chronic, ongoing gastrointestinal bleeding with continued iron loss (e.g., colonic angiodysplasia, inflammatory bowel disease, telangiectasia); (2) intolerance or lack of response to oral iron (GI side effects are common with oral iron); (3) malabsorption (celiac disease, after gastric bypass surgery); (4) need for rapid replenishment of stores (before surgery, advanced pregnancy); (5) chronic kidney disease treated with erythropoietin; (6) heart failure with iron deficiency. questions.question_en: In the treatment of aplastic anemia with an immunologic mechanism, which is the most appropriate treatment? - A) Danazol - B) Prednisolone - C) Cyclosporine ✅ - D) Myeloid growth factor (G-CSF)
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. دانازول (آندروژن) در برخی نارساییهای مغز استخوان و سندرمهای تلومری کاربرد محدود کمکی دارد، اما درمان اصلی مکانیسم ایمنی نیست.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. پردنیزولون بهتنهایی در آنمی آپلاستیک درمان مؤثری نیست و بیشتر برای کنترل بیماری سرم ناشی از ATG بهکار میرود.

صحیح است؛ صحیح. آنمی آپلاستیک با واسطهٔ ایمنی با درمان سرکوبکنندهٔ ایمنی درمان میشود؛ در بیمارانی که کاندید پیوند مغز استخوان نیستند، رژیم استاندارد ترکیب ATG + سیکلوسپورین است. در میان گزینهها، سیکلوسپورین (مهارکنندهٔ کلسینورین و لنفوسیتهای T مهاجم) درمان اختصاصی مکانیسم ایمنی است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نادرست. فاکتور رشد میلوئیدی (G-CSF) ممکن است کمکی و موقت باشد اما علت ایمنی زمینهای را درمان نمیکند و بهتنهایی پاسخ پایدار نمیدهد.

questions.explanation_fa: آنمی آپلاستیک (Aplastic anemia) یک نارسایی مغز استخوان است که با پانسیتوپنی محیطی (کاهش هر سه ردهٔ خونی) و مغز استخوان هیپوسلولار (جایگزینی با چربی) بدون سلولهای بدخیم یا فیبروز مشخص میشود. شایعترین شکل، آنمی آپلاستیک اکتسابی است که پاتوژنز آن عمدتاً ایمنی و با واسطهٔ لنفوسیتهای T سیتوتوکسیک است؛ این سلولهای T فعالشده با تولید سیتوکینها (اینترفرون گاما، TNF) سلولهای بنیادی خونساز را تخریب میکنند. علل: ایدیوپاتیک (اکثر موارد)، داروها و مواد شیمیایی (بنزن، کلرامفنیکل)، ویروسها (هپاتیت غیر A-G، EBV، HIV)، پرتو، و بیماریهای خودایمنی؛ همچنین باید اشکال ارثی (مانند کمخونی فانکونی) و همراهی با هموگلوبینوری حملهٔ شبانه (PNH) در نظر گرفته شود. تشخیص با شمارش کامل خون، رتیکولوسیت پایین و بیوپسی مغز ا…
questions.explanation_en: Aplastic anemia is a bone marrow failure characterized by peripheral pancytopenia (a decrease in all three blood lineages) and a hypocellular marrow (replaced by fat) without malignant cells or fibrosis. questions.explanation_fa: پلیسیتمی ورا (Polycythemia Vera, PV) یک نئوپلاسم میلوپرولیفراتیو مزمن (MPN) است که با تولید بیشازحد و مستقل گلبولهای قرمز (و اغلب افزایش پلاکت و لکوسیت) مشخص میشود و باید از پلیسیتمی ثانویه (واکنشی) افتراق داده شود. پاتوژنز PV تقریباً همیشه با جهش JAK2 مرتبط است: بیش از ۹۵٪ موارد جهش JAK2 V617F دارند که مسیر پیامرسانی JAK-STAT را مستقل از اریتروپویتین فعال میکند؛ در نتیجه اریتروپویتین سرم پایین است (برخلاف پلیسیتمی ثانویه که EPO بالا یا نرمال است). تظاهرات میکروواسکولار ناشی از افزایش گرانروی خون و اختلال عملکرد پلاکتی، مشخصهٔ بالینی مهم PV هستند و به افتراق آن از علل ثانویه کمک میکنند: اریتروملالژی (درد و قرمزی سوزشی دست و پا)، اختلالات بینایی گذرا، سردرد، سرگیجه، وزوز گوش، و خارش آبی/aqua…
questions.explanation_en: Polycythemia vera (PV) is a chronic myeloproliferative neoplasm (MPN) characterized by excessive, autonomous production of red blood cells (and often increased platelets and leukocytes) and must be distinguished from secondary (reactive) polycythemia. The pathogenesis of PV is almost always linked to a JAK2 mutation: more than 95% of cases have the JAK2 V617F mutation, which activates JAK-STAT signaling independently of erythropoietin; consequently serum erythropoietin is low (unlike secondary polycythemia, where EPO is high or normal). Microvascular manifestations, from increased blood viscosity and platelet dysfunction, are an important clinical feature of PV and help distinguish it from…

questions.explanation_en: Cervical spine instability, especially atlantoaxial subluxation, is a dangerous and often overlooked complication of long-standing rheumatoid arthritis (RA). RA is a systemic inflammatory disease that, besides peripheral joints, can involve the atlantoaxial joint (C1-C2); synovial inflammation (pannus) and destruction of the transverse atlantal ligament and the odontoid process cause instability and vertebral slippage. The danger is that in certain positions—especially neck hyperextension during endotracheal intubation under general anesthesia—subluxation can compress the cervical spinal cord and lead to catastrophic spinal cord injury (tetraplegia) or even death. The danger is that in certain positions—especially neck hyperextension during endotracheal intubation under general anesthesia—subluxation can compress the cervical spinal cord…

questions.explanation_en: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) is a life-threatening thrombotic microangiopathy with high mortality if not treated immediately. Pathophysiology: deficiency or inhibition of the ADAMTS13 enzyme (which cleaves large von Willebrand factor multimers) leads to accumulation of ultra-large vWF multimers and the formation of disseminated platelet thrombi in the microcirculation; these thrombi shear passing red cells (microangiopathic hemolysis with schistocytes) and platelets are consumed. TTP may be primary (autoimmune, anti-ADAMTS13 antibody) or secondary to autoimmune diseases (especially lupus/SLE), pregnancy, drugs, infection, and malignancy; association with lupus is common. questions.explanation_en: Reactive arthritis (formerly Reiter syndrome) is a seronegative spondyloarthropathy that occurs following an infection elsewhere in the body—usually the genitourinary tract (Chlamydia trachomatis) or gastrointestinal tract (Shigella, Salmonella, Campylobacter, Yersinia); it is a post-infectious immune reaction, and the organism is usually not found in the joint. It is associated with HLA-B27. The classic triad (not always complete): arthritis + urethritis + conjunctivitis ('can't see, can't pee, can't climb a tree'). questions.explanation_en: Giant cell arteritis (GCA; temporal arteritis) is the most common systemic vasculitis in older adults (>50 years, peak 70–80) and is a granulomatous vasculitis of medium and large vessels that particularly involves branches of the external carotid artery (temporal artery) and the ophthalmic artery. questions.explanation_fa: هموپتزی (خروج خون از دستگاه تنفسی تحتانی همراه سرفه) طیف وسیعی از علل دارد و رویکرد به آن بر اساس شدت خونریزی و ریسک بیمار تعیین میشود. از نظر شدت، هموپتزی به خفیف (لکههای خون در خلط) تا ماسیو (معمولاً >۱۰۰–۶۰۰ mL در ۲۴ ساعت یا خونریزی تهدیدکنندهٔ راه هوایی) تقسیم میشود. شایعترین علت هموپتزی خفیف، عفونتهای تنفسی—بهویژه برونشیت حاد و عفونتهای ویروسی دستگاه تنفسی فوقانی—است که با التهاب و آسیب سطحی مخاط و مویرگهای راه هوایی مقدار کمی خون ایجاد میکنند و خودمحدودند. سایر علل مهم که باید در نظر گرفته شوند: برونشکتازی، سل، پنومونی، آمبولی ریه، بدخیمی ریه (بهویژه در سیگاری مسن)، تنگی میترال و واسکولیتها (مانند گرانولوماتوز با پلیآنژیت). ارزیابی: شرححال (سن، سابقهٔ سیگار، مدت و مقدار، علائم همراه)،…
questions.explanation_en: Hemoptysis (coughing up blood from the lower respiratory tract) has a wide range of causes, and the approach is determined by bleeding severity and patient risk. By severity, hemoptysis ranges from mild (blood streaks in sputum) to massive (usually >100–600 mL in 24 hours or airway-threatening bleeding). The most common cause of mild hemoptysis is respiratory infection—especially acute bronchitis and viral upper respiratory infections—which produce a small amount of blood through inflammation and superficial injury of the mucosa and airway capillaries and are self-limited. questions.explanation_en: Tension pneumothorax is a life-threatening emergency in which air enters the pleural space through a one-way valve mechanism but cannot escape; progressively rising intrapleural pressure collapses the affected lung, shifts the mediastinum and trachea to the opposite side, impairs venous return to the heart, and severely reduces cardiac output, leading to obstructive shock and cardiac arrest. Causes: trauma, positive-pressure ventilation, invasive chest procedures (CVC, biopsy), and occasionally spontaneous. questions.explanation_en: Interpreting pulmonary function tests (PFT/spirometry) is based on identifying two main patterns: obstructive and restrictive. (1) Obstructive pattern: reduced FEV1/FVC ratio (<0.7 or below the lower limit of normal) due to expiratory flow limitation; seen in asthma, COPD, bronchiectasis. In COPD and asthma, lung volumes (TLC and RV) increase due to air trapping. (2) Restrictive pattern: reduced total lung capacity (TLC) and FVC, while the FEV1/FVC ratio is normal or even high (because both volumes decrease proportionally). questions.explanation_en: Pharmacologic management of stable chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is tailored to symptom severity and exacerbation risk and, increasingly, to the blood eosinophil count. Three main maintenance drug classes: (1) long-acting beta-agonists (LABA); (2) long-acting muscarinic antagonists (LAMA); (3) inhaled corticosteroids (ICS). The cornerstone of symptomatic treatment is long-acting bronchodilators (LABA and/or LAMA). questions.explanation_en: Right ventricular (RV) infarction often accompanies inferior myocardial infarction, since both usually result from occlusion of the right coronary artery (RCA). Recognizing this condition is vital because its treatment approach differs fundamentally from other infarcts. The classic clinical triad: hypotension + distended neck veins (raised JVP) + clear lungs (no congestion/rales); in a patient with inferior MI, this combination strongly suggests RV involvement. The diagnosis is confirmed by obtaining right-sided chest leads (especially V4R), which show ST elevation. questions.explanation_en: Pulsus paradoxus is an important clinical finding defined as a fall in systolic blood pressure of more than 10 mmHg during inspiration. The name 'paradoxical' comes from the fact that normally systolic pressure also falls slightly (less than 10 mmHg) during inspiration, but here the fall is exaggerated and significant. Mechanism: the phenomenon of 'ventricular interdependence.' questions.explanation_en: High-risk or massive pulmonary embolism (PE) refers to PE accompanied by hemodynamic instability: persistent hypotension (systolic <90 mmHg or a drop of ≥40 mmHg for >15 minutes), shock, or cardiac arrest. This state carries high mortality and requires immediate, aggressive treatment. Mechanism: extensive pulmonary vascular obstruction sharply increases right ventricular afterload, leading to acute right ventricular failure, reduced left ventricular filling, and hemodynamic collapse. questions.explanation_en: Hepatitis E (HEV) is an acute viral liver infection transmitted mainly by the fecal-oral route through contaminated water and food, and in rural areas and developing countries it is often seen as epidemic outbreaks with a common water source. In most healthy people, hepatitis E is self-limited and recovers without treatment. But the critical, frequently tested clinical point is the very high risk of acute fulminant liver failure in pregnant women—especially in the third trimester—with mortality that can reach 20–25% (versus <1% in the general population). questions.explanation_en: Acute pancreatitis is acute inflammation of the pancreas, initiated by premature activation of digestive enzymes within the gland and autodigestion of the tissue. Two common causes (>80%): gallstones (biliary) and alcohol; others include severe hypertriglyceridemia, hypercalcemia, drugs, ERCP, trauma, and idiopathic. questions.explanation_en: Crohn's disease is a chronic, segmental inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) that can involve any part of the gastrointestinal tract from mouth to anus, but the most common site is the terminal ileum and ileocecal region. It is characterized by transmural (full-thickness) inflammation, skip lesions, and granulomas, leading to complications such as strictures, fistulas, and abscesses. Crohn's treatment is tailored to location, severity, and disease behavior and has two main goals: inducing remission (induction) and maintaining remission (maintenance). questions.explanation_en: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by chronic abdominal pain related to defecation and a change in bowel pattern, without a structural or biochemical explanation. Diagnosis is based on the Rome IV criteria: recurrent abdominal pain on average at least one day per week over the past three months, with at least two of the following—(1) related to defecation (better or worse with passage of stool); (2) associated with a change in stool frequency; (3) associated with a change in stool consistency. Rarer causes: Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (gastrinoma), severe physiologic stress, and idiopathic ulcers. Duodenal ulcers are often associated with H. pylori and gastric ulcers more with NSAIDs. questions.question_en: A 55-year-old woman, T2DM 1 year on metformin 2g/day; FBS 175, HbA1c 8.7%, BMI 28. History of CAD and medullary thyroid cancer; BP 145/95; echo EF 35%. Best add-on drug class for glucose control? - A) Thiazolidinedione - B) DPP4 inhibitor - C) SGLT2 inhibitor ✅ - D) GLP-1 agonist
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: تیازولیدیندیون در نارسایی قلب (EF 35%) به دلیل احتباس مایع کنترااندیکه است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: DPP4i (بهویژه ساکساگلیپتین) منفعت قلبی ندارد و بستری نارسایی قلب را میتواند بالا ببرد؛ ارجح نیست.
صحیح است؛ SGLT2i در نارسایی قلب با EF کاهشیافته منفعت قوی (کاهش بستری و مرگ) دارد و کنترااندیکاسیون تیروئیدی ندارد؛ بهترین انتخاب.

questions.explanation_en: In a type 2 diabetic with two decisive comorbidities — heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF, EF=35%) and a history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) — the choice of a second agent must be driven by cardio-renal benefit and avoidance of contraindications, not glucose lowering alone. SGLT2 inhibitors (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin) are a cornerstone of HFrEF therapy irrespective of diabetes and reduce heart-failure hospitalization and cardiovascular death, making them the best add-on here. questions.question_fa: خانم ۳7 ساله ای با سابقه 1۰ ساله از هیپوتیروئیدی و مصرف داروی لوتیروکسین 7۰۰ میلی گرم در هفته، باتسرت بارداری مثبت جهت مشاوره مراجعه کرده است. تست تیروئید یک ماه قبل بیمارTSH=3.2 بروده اسرت. کردام توصیه به بیمار مناسب تر است؟ - الف) افزایش دوز لوتیروکسین به 900 میلی گرم در هفته ✅ - ب) افزایش دوز لوتیروکسین 50 - 45 درصد - ج) ادامه دوز دریافتی قبلی و تست مجدد دو تا سه ماه بعد - د) ادامه دوز دریافتی قبلی و تست مجدد یک ماه بعد
questions.question_en: A 37-year-old woman, 10-year hypothyroidism on levothyroxine 700 µg/week, now with positive pregnancy test, presents for counseling. TSH one month ago was 3.2. Best advice? - A) Increase levothyroxine to 900 µg/week ✅ - B) Increase levothyroxine by 45-50% - C) Continue current dose and retest in 2-3 months - D) Continue current dose and retest in 1 month
options_fa: افزایش دوز لوتیروکسین به 900 میلی گرم در هفته
ادامه دوز دریافتی قبلی و تست مجدد دو تا سه ماه بعد
ادامه دوز دریافتی قبلی و تست مجدد یک ماه بعد
options_why_fa: صحیح است؛ در بارداری نیاز به لووتیروکسین حدود ۳۰–۵۰٪ افزایش مییابد؛ افزایش ۷۰۰ به ۹۰۰ میکروگرم در هفته ≈ افزایش دو دوز اضافه در هفته (روش عملی «۲ قرص بیشتر در هفته») و منطبق با توصیهٔ استاندارد است.

نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: هرچند «۴۵–۵۰٪» از نظر مفهومی نزدیک است، عدد دقیق ۹۰۰ (≈۲۹٪) در گزینهٔ الف به صورت دستورالعمل عملی ارائه شده و پاسخ کلید است؛ افزایش ۵۰٪ (به ~۱۰۵۰) بیش از حد لازم برای TSH پایهٔ خوب است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: بهتعویقانداختن افزایش دوز و تست ۲–۳ ماه بعد خطر هیپوتیروئیدی جنینی در سهماههٔ اول را بالا میبرد؛ نادرست.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: صرفاً ادامهٔ دوز قبلی بدون افزایش، حتی با تست زودتر، نیاز افزایشیافتهٔ بارداری را پوشش نمیدهد.

questions.explanation_en: When a woman with hypothyroidism becomes pregnant, the levothyroxine requirement rises rapidly, usually by about 30–50%, because rising estrogen increases thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG), volume of distribution and hormone clearance, and the first-trimester fetus depends entirely on maternal thyroxine. The practical, widely used rule is that as soon as pregnancy is confirmed the patient takes 'two extra doses per week' (i.e., nine weekly doses instead of seven), roughly a 29% increase. TSH should then be checked every 4 weeks through the first half of pregnancy and the dose titrated to the first-trimester goal (TSH <2.5). questions.explanation_fa: دلیریوم ترمنس شدیدترین شکل سندرم ترک الکل است که معمولاً ۴۸ تا ۹۶ ساعت پس از قطع مصرف در فرد وابسته بروز میکند و با آژیتاسیون شدید، گیجی و عدم اورینتاسیون، توهم (اغلب بینایی)، بیثباتی اتونوم (تاکیکاردی، پرفشاری، تعریق، تب) و خطر تشنج مشخص میشود؛ مرگومیر درماننشده بالاست. پایهٔ درمان بنزودیازپینها (لورازپام یا دیازپام) هستند که با تقویت GABA بیشفعالی سیستم عصبی مرکزی ناشی از قطع الکل را مهار میکنند و از تشنج و پیشرفت به DT پیشگیری مینمایند؛ بهترین رویکرد دوزدهی مبتنی بر علائم (symptom-triggered) با مقیاس CIWA-Ar است. تیامین باید پیش از گلوکز تجویز شود تا از انسفالوپاتی ورنیکه جلوگیری شود. هالوپریدول تنها به عنوان کمکی برای توهم/آژیتاسیون مقاوم و با احتیاط (کاهش آستانهٔ تشنج) به کار میرود.
questions.explanation_en: Delirium tremens is the most severe form of alcohol-withdrawal syndrome, typically appearing 48–96 hours after cessation in a dependent person, marked by severe agitation, confusion and disorientation, hallucinations (often visual), autonomic instability (tachycardia, hypertension, diaphoresis, fever) and a risk of seizures; untreated mortality is high. Benzodiazepines (lorazepam or diazepam) are the mainstay: by enhancing GABA they suppress the CNS hyperexcitability of withdrawal and prevent seizures and progression to DT; symptom-triggered dosing guided by the CIWA-Ar scale is the preferred approach. questions.explanation_fa: در مراقبت تسکینی، تنگی نفس مقاوم (refractory dyspnea) یکی از ناتوانکنندهترین علائم بیماری پیشرفته مانند سرطان ریه است. مؤثرترین درمان دارویی، اپیوئیدهای سیستمیک کمدوز (مانند مورفین خوراکی یا زیرجلدی) هستند که با کاهش درک مرکزی تنگی نفس، تعدیل پاسخ تنفسی به هیپرکاپنی و کاهش کار تنفسی عمل میکنند؛ شروع با دوز پایین و تیتراسیون تدریجی بر اساس پاسخ توصیه میشود و در دوزهای تسکینی خطر دپرسیون تنفسی بالینی مهم اندک است. اکسیژندرمانی تنها در صورت هیپوکسمی سود میدهد و در بیمار نورموکسیک برتری بر هوای اتاق ندارد. بنزودیازپینها برای جزء اضطرابی همراه به عنوان کمکی استفاده میشوند. کورتیکواستروئید استنشاقی و ضدسرفهها در نبود انسداد یا سرفه نقشی در تسکین دیسپنه ندارند. بنابراین اپیوئید کمدوز انتخاب درست اس…
questions.explanation_en: In palliative care, refractory dyspnea is one of the most disabling symptoms of advanced disease such as lung cancer. The most effective pharmacologic treatment is low-dose systemic opioids (e.g., oral or subcutaneous morphine), which act by reducing central perception of breathlessness, blunting the ventilatory response to hypercapnia, and lowering the work of breathing; starting low and titrating to response is recommended, and at palliative doses the risk of clinically important respiratory depression is small. Oxygen therapy helps only when hypoxemia is present and offers no advantage over room air in a normoxic patient. Benzodiazepines are used adjunctively for an accompanying anxiety…

questions.question_en: A 64-year-old man with depression on duloxetine brought to ER with decreased consciousness. Recently used tramadol and dextromethorphan for body pain and URI. BP 150/100, RR 15, HR 110, SpO2 98%, T 40°C. Diaphoresis and tremor; mydriatic but symmetric reactive pupils; no meningeal signs; no focal deficit. Most likely diagnosis? - A) Tyramine reaction - B) Neuroleptic malignant syndrome - C) Tramadol poisoning - D) Serotonin syndrome ✅

questions.explanation_fa: آنوریسم آئورت شکمی (AAA) در بسیاری موارد بدون علامت است و اتفاقی کشف میشود؛ تصمیم به ترمیم بر پایهٔ قطر، سرعت رشد و علامتدار بودن گرفته میشود، نه سن یا صرفِ وجود آنوریسم. آستانهٔ ترمیم انتخابی (باز یا اندوواسکولار/EVAR) در مردان قطر ≥۵٫۵ سانتیمتر، در زنان ≥۵٫۰ سانتیمتر، رشد سریع بیش از ۱ سانتیمتر در سال، یا علامتدار شدن (درد، حساسیت، آمبولی) است. برای آنوریسمهای کوچکتر برنامهٔ پایش با سونوگرافی توصیه میشود: قطر ۳٫۰–۳٫۹ هر ۲–۳ سال، ۴٫۰–۴٫۹ هر ۶–۱۲ ماه، و ۵٫۰–۵٫۴ هر ۶ ماه. کنترل عوامل خطر — بهویژه ترک سیگار که مهمترین عامل رشد و پارگی است — و مدیریت فشار خون و لیپید ضروری است. در این بیمارِ بدون علامت با AAA اینفرارنال ۴٫۵ سانتیمتری، اقدام درست پایش دورهای است، نه جراحی یا مداخلهٔ اورژانس.
questions.explanation_en: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) is often asymptomatic and found incidentally; the decision to repair rests on diameter, growth rate and symptoms, not age or mere presence. The threshold for elective repair (open or endovascular/EVAR) is a diameter ≥5.5 cm in men, ≥5.0 cm in women, rapid growth of more than 1 cm/year, or symptoms (pain, tenderness, embolization). For smaller aneurysms an ultrasound surveillance schedule is advised: 3.0–3.9 cm every 2–3 years, 4.0–4.9 cm every 6–12 months, and 5.0–5.4 cm every 6 months. There are three main scenarios: if the vessels and vas end blindly within the abdomen (blind-ending), the diagnosis is a vanishing testis and no further exploration is needed. If the spermatic vessels enter the inguinal canal, the testis or its remnant lies in the canal or scrotum and inguinal exploration must be performed — an atrophic/nubbin testis is removed and a viable testis undergoes orchiopexy. Category III (AUS/FLUS: atypia of undetermined significance) carries an intermediate malignancy risk, and management options include repeat FNA, molecular testing (e.g., Afirma or ThyroSeq), or diagnostic lobectomy. When a second FNA again reports FLUS (recurrent Bethesda III) and molecular testing is unavailable or negative, diagnostic lobectomy is the standard step to define the nodule; if malignancy is confirmed, completion thyroidectomy is performed according to risk. questions.explanation_en: Barrett's esophagus is replacement of esophageal squamous epithelium by intestinal-type columnar epithelium (metaplasia) in the setting of chronic reflux and is a precursor of esophageal adenocarcinoma; progression risk correlates with the degree of dysplasia, which drives management. In Barrett's without dysplasia, a PPI plus endoscopic surveillance every 3–5 years suffices. questions.explanation_en: In blunt abdominal trauma with solid-organ injury (liver or spleen), the decisive factor in management is, above all, hemodynamic status. An unstable patient or one with peritonitis needs immediate laparotomy. A stable patient is a candidate for non-operative management with close ICU monitoring, serial hemoglobin and examination. However, active contrast extravasation (a contrast blush) on CT signals active arterial bleeding, and in a stable patient angiography with angioembolization is the treatment of choice to control hemorrhage and preserve the organ; this is part of modern non-operative management and avoids unnecessary laparotomy. questions.explanation_en: Hepatic hemangioma is the most common benign liver tumor and is usually found incidentally on imaging. In fact, percutaneous biopsy of a hemangioma is contraindicated because of bleeding risk. questions.explanation_en: The ACOSOG Z0011 trial changed axillary management in early breast cancer. Under it, a patient with a T1–T2 tumor who has undergone lumpectomy (breast-conserving surgery), has 1 or 2 positive sentinel lymph nodes, and receives whole-breast radiotherapy and systemic therapy does not gain a survival benefit from completion axillary dissection (ALND), which can be omitted; this reduces complications such as lymphedema. The choice of systemic therapy depends on the tumor's biologic subtype: in ER/PR-negative (and especially triple-negative) tumors, endocrine therapy such as tamoxifen is ineffective and chemotherapy is required; tamoxifen has a role only in hormone-receptor-positive tumors. questions.explanation_en: Sigmoid volvulus is torsion of the sigmoid loop around its mesentery and is the most common cause of colonic obstruction in elderly nursing-home residents with chronic constipation and a redundant colon (dolichocolon). The classic plain-film finding is a dilated 'coffee-bean' or 'omega' loop extending from the pelvis toward the upper quadrant. HR:92, BP: 118/72 mmHg. در لمس شرکم نررم اسرت و.اتساع خفیف همراه با تندرنس عمقی بدون ریباند دارد درCT با کنتراست، ورید مزانتریک فوقانی متسع براfilling defect تا ورید پورت رویت می شود، ضخیم شدن حلقروی دیرواره سسنروم دیسرتال و ایلئروم پروگزیمرال همرراه برا استرندینگ مزانتر بدون هوای آزاد یا پنوماتوز روده وجود دارد. مناسب ترین گام بعدی در درمان چیست؟ - الف) آنتی کوآگوالسیون فوری با هپارین ✅ - ب) الپاراتومی با رزکسیون روده باریک - ج) ترومبکتومی مکانیکی و ترومبولیز موضعی - د) آنتی بیوتیک وسیع الطیف و تکرارCT شکم

Afebrile, HR 92, BP 118/72; soft abdomen with mild distension and deep tenderness without rebound. Contrast CT: dilated superior mesenteric vein with filling defect extending to portal vein, circumferential wall thickening of distal cecum and proximal ileum with mesenteric stranding, no free air or pneumatosis. Best next step in treatment? - A) Immediate anticoagulation with heparin ✅ - B) Laparotomy with small-bowel resection - C) Mechanical thrombectomy and local thrombolysis - D) Broad-spectrum antibiotics and repeat abdominal CT

questions.explanation_en: Acute mesenteric vein thrombosis (MVT) is a form of mesenteric ischemia and often occurs in patients with an inherited or acquired prothrombotic state (e.g., factor V Leiden, prior DVT). Presentation is usually subacute and vague: abdominal pain out of proportion to examination, mild distension, nausea and diarrhea. Diagnosis is confirmed by contrast CT angiography, showing a filling defect in the superior mesenteric/portal vein, bowel-wall thickening and mesenteric stranding. The key management point is assessing for bowel infarction: signs of necrosis/perforation include intestinal pneumatosis, free air and peritonitis. questions.explanation_en: Caustic ingestion (acid or alkali) is a gastrointestinal emergency. Prohibited actions include inducing vomiting (which re-exposes the mucosa to the agent), chemical neutralization (which causes an exothermic reaction and more injury), and activated charcoal (which obscures endoscopic view and is useless). Initial management is airway stabilization, NPO status and assessment. Early endoscopy (usually within the first 12–24 hours) is recommended to grade the severity of injury; performing it later than this window is dangerous because of wall softening and perforation risk. questions.explanation_en: In head trauma, distinguishing a subdural from an epidural hematoma is based on shape, vascular source and behavior relative to suture lines. questions.explanation_en: Tension pneumothorax is a life-threatening emergency and a cause of obstructive shock, in which air trapped in the pleural space increases with each breath, collapses the lung and shifts the mediastinum to the opposite side, impairing venous return and cardiac output. Manifestations include severe respiratory distress, decreased or absent unilateral breath sounds, hypotension, tachycardia, distended neck veins and tracheal deviation to the opposite side. The critical point is that the diagnosis is clinical and one must not wait for an X-ray or echocardiogram, since delay can be fatal. questions.explanation_en: An acute hemolytic transfusion reaction is usually caused by ABO incompatibility (often from a patient/product identification error) and is a life-threatening emergency. Symptoms that begin during or immediately after transfusion include fever and chills, chest and back (flank) pain, respiratory distress, hypotension, hemoglobinuria and, in severe cases, DIC and acute kidney injury. The first and most important action is to stop the transfusion immediately. The IV line should then be kept open with normal saline and aggressive hydration with maintained diuresis performed to protect the kidneys from free-hemoglobin injury; fluid restriction in this situation is an error. Volume resuscitation uses isotonic solutions (normal saline or Ringer's lactate) without potassium and at a high rate. questions.question_fa: یک بیمار ۴۵ ساله با سابقه آرتریت روماتوئید، به مدت ۲ هفته اخیر روزانه ۲۵ میلی گررم پردنیزولرون دریافرت کرده است و کاندید جراحی توتال کولکتومی الکتیو و آناستوموز ایلئورکتال به علت پولیپوز کولرون مری.باشرد کدام گزینه در مورد این بیمار صحیح است؟ - الف) باتوجه به احتمال لیک آناستوموز روده ای پرخط،ر توصیه به قطع کورتیکواستروئید از 72 ساعت قبل از جراحی می.باشد - ب) مصرف دوز معمول کورتیکواستروئید روزانه.ی بیمار تا صبح روز جراحی کافیست ✅ - ج) مصرف استرس دوز هیدروکورتیزون به میزانmg 50 قبل از شروع عمل جراحی و ادامه تجوویز آن بوه میوزانmg 25 هر 8 ساعت توصیه می شود. - د) مصرف استرس دوز هیدروکورتیزون به میزانmg 100 قبل از شروع عمل جراحی و ادامه تجویز آن بوه میوزانmg 50 هر 8 ساعت توصیه می شود.

questions.explanation_en: Chronic glucocorticoid use can suppress the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis and create a risk of adrenal crisis under surgical stress; however, the threshold for clinically important suppression is usually a prednisolone-equivalent dose of ≥20 mg/day for ≥3 weeks. Short-term use (such as two weeks) does not necessarily produce sustained suppression. The modern approach has restricted 'stress dosing': in patients with an intact or unlikely-suppressed axis, continuing the usual daily dose up to the morning of surgery is sufficient and high stress doses are not needed; abrupt steroid withdrawal is also dangerous and not recommended. Colonoscopy a month ago showed only diverticula. questions.explanation_fa: فیستول کولووزیکال (ارتباط غیرطبیعی بین کولون و مثانه) شایعترین نوع فیستول مثانهای است و شایعترین علت آن بیماری دیورتیکولی (دیورتیکولیت) است؛ علل دیگر شامل سرطان کولون و بیماری کرون میباشد. تظاهرات کلاسیک شامل پنوماتوری (دفع هوا از مجرای ادرار)، فکالوری (دفع مواد مدفوعی در ادرار) و عفونت ادراری مکرر و پلیمیکروبیال است. یافتهٔ سیتیاسکن با ارزشترین ابزار تشخیصی است و وجود هوا در مثانه (در نبود ابزار/کاتتریزاسیون اخیر) بسیار مطرحکننده است. پیش از جراحی باید بدخیمی با کولونوسکوپی رد شود. درمان قطعی در بیمار مناسب، جراحی یکمرحلهای است: رزکسیون سگمان درگیر کولون، جدا کردن و ترمیم (بستن) بخش درگیر مثانه و آناستوموز اولیهٔ روده. اقدامات موقتی مانند استنت، کولوستومی انحرافی یا انتظار درمان قطعی نیستن…
questions.explanation_en: A colovesical fistula (an abnormal connection between the colon and bladder) is the most common type of vesical fistula, and its most common cause is diverticular disease (diverticulitis); other causes include colon cancer and Crohn's disease. Classic manifestations are pneumaturia (passing air in the urine), fecaluria (passing fecal material in the urine) and recurrent, polymicrobial urinary tract infections. CT is the most valuable diagnostic tool, and air in the bladder (without recent instrumentation/catheterization) is highly suggestive. Before surgery, malignancy must be excluded by colonoscopy. questions.explanation_en: Tetanus prophylaxis is determined by two factors: the person's immunization history and the type of wound (clean vs. dirty/tetanus-prone). A tetanus-prone wound includes wounds contaminated with soil/feces, crush wounds, burns, and deep puncture wounds. In a person who has received the full vaccine series (≥3 doses): for a clean wound, a booster is needed only if >10 years have elapsed since the last dose; and for a dirty/prone wound, a booster is needed only if >5 years have elapsed. Tetanus immunoglobulin (TIG) is given only to people with incomplete or unknown immunization who have a high-risk wound, not to a fully immunized person. questions.explanation_en: The Parkland formula estimates fluid requirements in the first 24 hours of a burn: 4 mL × weight (kg) × percent total body surface area burned (%TBSA), with half given in the first 8 hours (from the time of the burn) and the other half over the next 16 hours. The key point is that only partial-thickness (second-degree) and full-thickness (third-degree) burns are counted in the TBSA calculation, and a superficial first-degree burn (painful erythema without blisters that fades within hours) is not counted. questions.explanation_en: Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a rare but highly aggressive cutaneous neuroendocrine tumor that most often arises in sun-exposed areas (head and neck) in older or immunosuppressed people and is associated with Merkel cell polyomavirus. It typically presents as a firm, painless, rapidly growing nodule. The tumor has a high tendency for lymphatic (lymphotropic) spread and distant metastasis, so evaluation of regional lymph nodes with sentinel node biopsy is a standard part of staging and treatment. questions.explanation_en: In groin hernia repair, the choice of technique depends on the patient's sex, the hernia type and whether it is bilateral/recurrent. Femoral hernia is more common in women and, because of its tight, rigid ring, is prone to incarceration and strangulation, so its repair is especially important. The advantage of the laparoscopic approach (TEP or TAPP) with mesh is that it covers the entire 'myopectineal orifice' and simultaneously repairs the inguinal (direct and indirect) and femoral defects; for this reason it is the preferred approach in situations such as bilateral hernia, recurrent hernia, and especially in women or when a concurrent femoral hernia is suspected. It presents with right-upper-quadrant pain, fever, leukocytosis and a positive Murphy's sign, and ultrasound shows stones, gallbladder wall thickening and pericholecystic fluid. A mild rise in bilirubin is common in acute cholecystitis without common bile duct obstruction; however, if liver enzymes and bilirubin are markedly elevated, a common bile duct stone (choledocholithiasis) or cholangitis should be considered and ERCP contemplated. questions.explanation_en: Meckel's diverticulum is the most common congenital anomaly of the gastrointestinal tract and is a remnant of the vitelline (omphalomesenteric) duct; the 'rule of twos' describes it: about 2% of the population, usually within ~60 cm (2 feet) of the ileocecal valve, about 2 inches long, and often symptomatic under age 2. During laparoscopy for suspected appendicitis, if the appendix is found to be normal, the whole bowel (especially the terminal ileum) should be inspected for other causes of pain, including a Meckel's diverticulum. In hypernatremia, water is drawn from inside cells into the extracellular space, dehydrating brain cells; its characteristic clinical features include doughy skin, irritability, lethargy, muscular hypertonia and hyperreflexia, and in severe cases seizures. questions.explanation_fa: بیماری کرون یکی از دو نوع اصلی بیماری التهابی روده (IBD) است که با درگیری تمامضخامت (transmural) دیوارهٔ روده و درگیری قطعهقطعه (skip lesions) از دهان تا مقعد مشخص میشود. همین ماهیت transmural علت بارز آن یعنی بیماری پریآنال است: فیستول، فیشور، آبسه و skin tag که تقریباً اختصاصی کرون است و در کولیت اولسراتیو (که سطحی و پیوسته و محدود به کولون است) دیده نمیشود. تظاهرات بالینی شامل درد کرامپی شکم بهویژه پس از غذا، اسهال مزمن، کاهش اشتها، کاهش وزن و تأخیر رشد در کودکان است. تظاهرات خارجرودهای شایع شامل اریتم ندوزوم (ندولهای قرمز دردناک ساق پا)، آرتریت، یووئیت و پیودرما گانگرنوزوم میباشد. تشخیص با کولونوسکوپی و بیوپسی (گرانولوم غیرکازئیفیه)، کلسپروتکتین مدفوع و انتروگرافی MR انجام میشود. در این…
questions.explanation_en: Crohn's disease is one of the two main types of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), characterized by transmural involvement of the bowel wall and segmental involvement (skip lesions) from mouth to anus. This transmural nature explains its hallmark, perianal disease: fistula, fissure, abscess and skin tags, which are almost specific to Crohn's and are not seen in ulcerative colitis (which is superficial, continuous and limited to the colon). Clinical features include cramping abdominal pain, especially after meals, chronic diarrhea, anorexia, weight loss and growth delay in children. options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: نقص سیکل اوره با هایپرآمونمی و آلکالوز تنفسی و بدون هایپوگلیسمی/کاردیومیوپاتی تظاهر میکند.
صحیح است؛ هایپوگلیسمی هیپوکتوتیک (عدم کتون در ادرار) + هیپوتونی + کاردیومیوپاتی = اختلال اکسیداسیون اسیدهای چرب (مثل نقص LCHAD/VLCAD)؛ چون چربی نمیتواند به انرژی/کتون تبدیل شود.

نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: اختلال متابولیسم اسیدهای آمینه معمولاً با اسیدوز متابولیک/بوی خاص ادرار و بدون این سهگانه است.

questions.explanation_fa: اختلالات اکسیداسیون اسیدهای چرب (Fatty Acid Oxidation Disorders) گروهی از خطاهای مادرزادی متابولیسماند که در آنها بدن نمیتواند اسیدهای چرب را برای تولید انرژی و کتون در زمان ناشتایی یا استرس بشکند. در حالت طبیعی، هنگام ناشتایی پس از مصرف ذخایر گلیکوژن، بدن به اکسیداسیون چربی و تولید کتون روی میآورد؛ در این اختلالات این مسیر مسدود است و نتیجه، هایپوگلیسمی هیپوکتوتیک (قند پایین بدون کتون در ادرار) است. چون قلب و عضلات اسکلتی برای انرژی به اسیدهای چرب وابستهاند، تجمع متابولیتهای سمی و کمبود انرژی موجب کاردیومیوپاتی، هیپوتونی، ضعف عضلانی و اختلال کبدی میشود. نمونهها شامل نقص VLCAD و LCHAD (که تظاهر نوزادی زودرس و شدید با کاردیومیوپاتی دارند) و نقص MCAD (که معمولاً دیرتر بروز میکند) است. تشخیص ب…
questions.explanation_en: Fatty acid oxidation disorders are a group of inborn errors of metabolism in which the body cannot break down fatty acids to produce energy and ketones during fasting or stress. Normally, during fasting after glycogen stores are depleted, the body turns to fat oxidation and ketone production; in these disorders this pathway is blocked, resulting in hypoketotic hypoglycemia (low glucose without urine ketones). Because the heart and skeletal muscle depend on fatty acids for energy, accumulation of toxic metabolites and energy deficiency cause cardiomyopathy, hypotonia, muscle weakness and liver dysfunction. questions.explanation_en: Chronic nonspecific diarrhea of toddlers (toddler's diarrhea) is the most common cause of chronic diarrhea in children aged 1–5 years, and its key feature is that it is accompanied by normal growth and development; that is, the child's weight and height remain within an appropriate range and the child appears healthy. Its main cause is excessive intake of juice and high-sugar fluids containing fructose and sorbitol; these sugars are not fully absorbed in the gut and, by creating an osmotic load, draw water into the bowel lumen and cause watery diarrhea. questions.explanation_en: In patients with severe primary immunodeficiency, especially cellular immunodeficiencies such as SCID (severe combined immunodeficiency), administration of live attenuated vaccines is contraindicated, because the weakened vaccine organism can replicate in a person lacking effective immunity and cause serious, sometimes fatal, vaccine-derived disease. Live vaccines to avoid include rotavirus (oral), BCG, MMR (measles-mumps-rubella), varicella, oral polio (OPV) and yellow fever. questions.question_en: A 7-year-old girl admitted with fever and myalgia. Exam: arthritis of the right knee and both ankles starting yesterday, bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy, diffuse urticarial lesions and periorbital swelling. History of antibiotic use in the past 2 weeks. Labs: thrombocytopenia and low complement. Most likely diagnosis? - A) Acute urticaria and angioedema - B) Stevens-Johnson syndrome - C) Juvenile idiopathic arthritis - D) Serum sickness ✅
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: کهیر و آنژیوادم حاد آرتریت، لنفادنوپاتی و کاهش کمپلمان را با هم ندارد.

questions.explanation_fa: بیماری سرم (serum sickness) یک واکنش ازدیاد حساسیت نوع III (با واسطهٔ کمپلکس ایمنی) است که معمولاً حدود ۱ تا ۳ هفته پس از مواجهه با داروی مسبب (اغلب آنتیبیوتیکهایی مانند سفاکلور یا پنیسیلینها، یا پروتئینهای خارجی و آنتیسرمها) رخ میدهد. مکانیسم آن تشکیل کمپلکسهای آنتیژن-آنتیبادی است که در بافتها رسوب میکنند، کمپلمان را فعال میکنند و التهاب ایجاد مینمایند؛ به همین دلیل سطح کمپلمان سرم (C3 و C4) کاهش مییابد. تظاهرات بالینی شامل تب، راش (اغلب کهیری یا سرخکی)، آرتریت یا آرترالژی، لنفادنوپاتی، و گاهی ترومبوسیتوپنی و پروتئینوری است. این ترکیب — بهویژه شروع پس از دارو همراه با کهیر، آرتریت و افت کمپلمان — بیماری سرم را از تشخیصهای افتراقی مانند JIA، SJS یا کهیر سادهٔ حاد متمایز میکند. بیماری خودمحد…
questions.explanation_en: Serum sickness is a type III hypersensitivity reaction (immune-complex mediated) that usually occurs about 1–3 weeks after exposure to a causative drug (often antibiotics such as cefaclor or penicillins, or foreign proteins and antisera). Its mechanism is the formation of antigen-antibody complexes that deposit in tissues, activate complement and cause inflammation; for this reason serum complement levels (C3 and C4) fall. Clinical manifestations include fever, rash (often urticarial or morbilliform), arthritis or arthralgia, lymphadenopathy, and sometimes thrombocytopenia and proteinuria. This combination — especially onset after a drug together with urticaria, arthritis and low complement…

questions.explanation_en: Organophosphate poisoning (agricultural pesticides and insecticides) occurs through irreversible inhibition of the enzyme acetylcholinesterase; the result is accumulation of acetylcholine at synapses and overstimulation of cholinergic receptors. This produces two groups of symptoms. Muscarinic symptoms, known by the acronyms DUMBELS (Defecation, Urination, Miosis, Bradycardia, Emesis, Lacrimation, Salivation) or SLUDGE, include miosis, lacrimation, salivation, bradycardia, copious pulmonary secretions (crackles), sweating, nausea and diarrhea. questions.explanation_en: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is the most common lethal autosomal recessive disease in Caucasians, caused by mutations in the CFTR gene and impaired chloride and water transport, producing thick, sticky secretions in the lungs, pancreas and intestine. Manifestations include recurrent and chronic respiratory infections with productive cough, exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (steatorrhea, malabsorption, growth delay) and, in neonates, meconium ileus. Diagnosis is confirmed by a sweat test; a sweat chloride ≥60 mEq/L is diagnostic (30–59 borderline and <30 normal). questions.explanation_en: Wilson's disease is an autosomal recessive disorder of copper metabolism caused by mutations in the ATP7B gene, leading to impaired biliary excretion of copper from the liver and consequent copper accumulation in the liver, brain (especially the basal ganglia), cornea and kidney. Presentation in children and adolescents is often hepatic (hepatitis, cirrhosis, acute liver failure) and at older ages predominantly neurologic and psychiatric: dysarthria, dysphagia, tremor, dystonia, personality change, decline in school performance. questions.explanation_en: Tricuspid valve atresia is a cyanotic congenital heart disease in which the tricuspid valve fails to form and there is no connection between the right atrium and right ventricle; consequently the right ventricle is hypoplastic (small). Survival depends on shunts: blood passes from the right atrium through an atrial septal defect (ASD/PFO) to the left atrium, and pulmonary blood flow depends on a patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) or a VSD. The key, almost pathognomonic electrocardiographic point is that tricuspid atresia is the only cyanotic heart disease that presents in a neonate with left-axis deviation (LAD) and left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH), because the dominant ventricle is the left.…

questions.explanation_en: Febrile seizure is the most common seizure disorder of childhood and usually occurs between 6 months and 5 years of age. Two different concepts must be distinguished: the risk of recurrent febrile seizures and the risk of developing epilepsy (afebrile seizures) later. Risk factors for recurrent febrile seizures include a young age at onset (under 18 months), a family history of febrile seizures, a short duration of fever before the seizure and a lower temperature at the time of the seizure. questions.explanation_en: Steatorrhea (excess fat in the stool) is a sign of fat malabsorption, which in infants is often due to exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (deficiency of lipolytic enzymes); its most common causes are cystic fibrosis and Shwachman-Diamond syndrome. The stool in this condition is bulky, foul-smelling, greasy and floats, and fat droplets are sometimes visible. Several tests are available for evaluation: a fecal Sudan stain is only a qualitative test to confirm the presence of fat; 72-hour fecal fat collection is the quantitative gold standard but is difficult, impractical in an infant, and does not identify the cause. Fecal elastase-1 is the best and most practical non-invasive test of exocrine…

questions.explanation_en: Cellulitis around the eye is divided into two important types whose distinction is critical. questions.explanation_en: Acute otitis media is one of the most common bacterial infections in children, and its most common agents are Streptococcus pneumoniae, non-typeable Haemophilus influenzae and Moraxella catarrhalis. The foreign body most often lodges in the right main bronchus (which is more vertical and wider). questions.explanation_en: Blood pressure classification in children follows the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP 2017) guideline using percentile tables based on the child's age, sex and height, because fixed adult values do not apply. For children under 13 years, the classification is: normal blood pressure below the 90th percentile; elevated blood pressure from the 90th to less than the 95th percentile (or 120/80 to less than the 95th percentile); stage 1 hypertension from the 95th percentile to less than the 95th percentile plus 12 mmHg (or 130/80 to 139/89); and stage 2 hypertension equal to or greater than the 95th percentile plus 12 mmHg (or 140/90 and above). questions.explanation_en: Breast milk is the best source of nutrition for an infant, but it is inadequate in some micronutrients, the most important being vitamin D. The vitamin D concentration in breast milk is low and cannot meet the infant's needs; its deficiency leads to rickets (softening of bones), growth delay and, in severe cases, seizures from hypocalcemia. For this reason the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) recommends that all breastfed and partially breastfed infants receive 400 international units (IU) of vitamin D daily from the first days of life, continuing until the child consumes at least one liter of vitamin D-fortified milk or formula per day. questions.question_en: A 32-year-old G1P0 at 39 weeks gestation is placed supine for ultrasound. A few minutes later she develops dizziness, nausea, cold sweating and weakness; BP falls from 120/75 to 90/55 and HR rises to 110. Placing her in left lateral position rapidly resolves symptoms. Which explanation is correct? - A) Decreased stroke volume from increased systemic vascular resistance - B) Decreased venous return and cardiac output from inferior vena cava compression ✅ - C) Direct decrease in cerebral perfusion from abdominal aorta compression - D) Decreased maternal blood volume in late pregnancy from shunting to uteroplacental circulation

questions.explanation_en: Supine hypotension syndrome is a common hemodynamic phenomenon in the third trimester of pregnancy that occurs when a pregnant woman lies on her back (supine). In this position, the enlarged uterus presses on and compresses the inferior vena cava (IVC), which lies to the right of the spine; the result is decreased venous return to the heart (reduced preload), a drop in stroke volume and cardiac output, and consequently a fall in blood pressure. The body responds with compensatory tachycardia. Symptoms include dizziness, nausea, cold sweat, pallor and a feeling of weakness, which resolve rapidly with a change to the left lateral position (which relieves pressure on the IVC). questions.explanation_en: CIN3 (cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3) is a high-grade precancerous lesion treated with excisional methods such as LEEP (loop electrosurgical excision). When the pathology report shows a positive surgical margin (involved with CIN3), the risk of residual disease or recurrence is higher and closer follow-up is needed. The approach depends on the patient's desire for fertility. questions.explanation_en: Preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) refers to rupture of the fetal membranes before 37 weeks and before the onset of labor and is an important cause of preterm birth and infection. Management of PPROM remote from term (when continuing the pregnancy is intended) includes several standard interventions. Corticosteroids (betamethasone or dexamethasone) are recommended to accelerate fetal lung maturity and reduce respiratory distress syndrome up to 34 weeks (and in selected cases up to 36+6). questions.explanation_en: Theca-lutein cysts are bilateral, often multiloculated ovarian cysts that arise from excessive ovarian stimulation by high levels of hCG; for this reason they are commonly seen in molar pregnancy (especially complete mole), multiple gestation and gestational trophoblastic disease. Because the underlying cause of these cysts is hormonal stimulation, after evacuation of the mole and the gradual fall and normalization of hCG, these cysts regress spontaneously over weeks to months and disappear. questions.explanation_en: Stress urinary incontinence is the most common type of urinary incontinence in women and refers to involuntary leakage of urine during increased intra-abdominal pressure (such as coughing, sneezing, laughing, exercise or lifting heavy objects) without detrusor contraction. Its main and most common cause is loss of the anatomic support of the pelvic floor and the anterior vaginal compartment, leading to hypermobility of the urethra and bladder neck; in this situation, when intra-abdominal pressure rises, the pressure is not transmitted equally to the urethra and leakage occurs. A less common cause is intrinsic sphincter deficiency. Risk factors include vaginal delivery, obesity, aging and me…

questions.explanation_en: Mayer-Rokitansky-Kuster-Hauser (MRKH) syndrome, or Mullerian agenesis, results from failure of development of the Mullerian (paramesonephric) ducts, leading to absence or hypoplasia of the uterus and the upper two-thirds of the vagina; it is the second most common cause of primary amenorrhea after Turner syndrome. The key point is that the ovaries, which have a different origin, are normal and functional; therefore estrogen production and ovulation are normal and secondary sexual characteristics (breast development, pubic and axillary hair) develop fully. questions.explanation_en: Medical treatment of ectopic pregnancy with methotrexate (a folate antagonist that inhibits trophoblast cell proliferation) is used in selected, hemodynamically stable patients with a small size and not-too-high hCG. questions.explanation_en: The levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine device (LNG-IUD) is a highly effective, long-acting contraceptive method that works by locally releasing progestin into the uterine cavity. One of its main and expected effects is progressive thinning (atrophy) of the endometrium, leading to a significant reduction in menstrual bleeding, oligomenorrhea and, in many women, amenorrhea (complete cessation of menses) within the first months to a year of use. This amenorrhea is a desirable and safe effect and is not a sign of early menopause or a problem; in fact, ovulation continues in many women and ovarian function is normal. questions.explanation_en: Severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) is a leading cause of maternal mortality, and its management depends on rapid, effective resuscitation of volume and blood products. When bleeding becomes massive (as in this patient, who received 5 units of packed red cells in one hour with ongoing bleeding), giving packed red cells (PRBCs) alone is insufficient and leads to dilutional coagulopathy, because clotting factors and platelets are not replaced and bleeding worsens. questions.explanation_fa: ماکروزومی جنینی به وزن تخمینی جنین بیش از یک آستانهٔ معین گفته میشود و مهمترین خطر آن دیستوشی شانه (گیرکردن شانهٔ جنین پس از خروج سر) و عوارض ناشی از آن مانند آسیب پلکسوس بازویی (فلج ارب)، شکستگی استخوان و آسفیکسی است. دیابت مادر یکی از عوامل خطر اصلی ماکروزومی است و همچنین بهطور مستقل خطر دیستوشی شانه را در هر وزن معین بالا میبرد، زیرا توزیع چربی جنین بهسمت تنه و شانهها بیشتر است. بر اساس توصیهٔ ACOG، برای پیشگیری از این عوارض، سزارین انتخابی زمانی توصیه میشود که وزن تخمینی جنین در مادر دیابتی برابر یا بیش از ۴۵۰۰ گرم و در مادر غیردیابتی برابر یا بیش از ۵۰۰۰ گرم باشد. نکتهٔ مهم این است که سابقهٔ زایمان واژینال بدون عارضهٔ قبلی با وزن کمتر (۳۹۰۰ گرم)، خطر فعلی ماکروزومی شدید را رفع نمیکند.…
questions.explanation_en: Fetal macrosomia refers to an estimated fetal weight above a defined threshold, and its most important risk is shoulder dystocia (impaction of the fetal shoulder after delivery of the head) and its complications such as brachial plexus injury (Erb's palsy), bone fracture and asphyxia. Maternal diabetes is a major risk factor for macrosomia and also independently raises the risk of shoulder dystocia at any given weight, because fetal fat distribution is greater toward the trunk and shoulders. questions.explanation_en: Magnesium sulfate has two main, distinct uses in preterm labor that should not be confused. The first use is tocolysis (reducing uterine contractions), which is now used less for this purpose. However, its important and proven use is fetal neuroprotection: giving magnesium sulfate to the mother before anticipated preterm birth at gestational ages less than 32 weeks significantly reduces the risk and severity of cerebral palsy and major motor dysfunction in the neonate. Its exact mechanism is not fully clear but probably includes reducing oxidative injury and glutamate-induced excitotoxicity and stabilizing cerebral blood flow. questions.explanation_fa: سندرم HELLP یک شکل شدید و تهدیدکنندهٔ حیات پرهاکلامپسی است که با سهگانهٔ همولیز (Hemolysis)، افزایش آنزیمهای کبدی (Elevated Liver enzymes) و کاهش پلاکت (Low Platelets) تعریف میشود. این سندرم میتواند بهسرعت پیشرفت کند و به عوارض جدی مادری مانند خونریزی، DIC، پارگی یا هماتوم کبد، نارسایی کلیه و مرگ منجر شود. در این بیمار، در طول تنها ۶ ساعت، پلاکت از ۱۰۰,۰۰۰ به ۵۵,۰۰۰ افت کرده و آنزیمهای کبدی و LDH افزایش یافتهاند که نشاندهندهٔ وخامت سریع است. اصل کلیدی مدیریت HELLP این است که درمان قطعی، ختم بارداری است و در فرم رو به وخامت، این ختم باید فوری و صرفنظر از سن حاملگی انجام شود؛ بهتعویقانداختن آن برای تکمیل دورهٔ کورتیکواستروئید یا انتظار بیشتر خطر مادری بالایی دارد. سولفات منیزیم باید برای پیشگ…
questions.explanation_en: HELLP syndrome is a severe, life-threatening form of pre-eclampsia defined by the triad of Hemolysis, Elevated Liver enzymes and Low Platelets. It can progress rapidly and lead to serious maternal complications such as hemorrhage, DIC, hepatic rupture or hematoma, renal failure and death. In this patient, over just 6 hours, the platelet count fell from 100,000 to 55,000 and liver enzymes and LDH rose, indicating rapid deterioration. Her menses are regular and her husband's semen analysis is normal. Next step? - A) Hysterosalpingography ✅ - B) Diagnostic laparoscopy - C) Pelvic MRI - D) Diagnostic hysteroscopy
options_why_fa: صحیح است؛ با سابقهٔ حاملگی لولهای، عامل لولهای محتملترین علت ناباروری است؛ با قاعدگی منظم (تخمکگذاری احتمالی) و اسپرم نرمال، ارزیابی باز بودن لوله با هیستروسالپنگوگرافی (HSG) گام بعدی صحیح است.

questions.explanation_fa: ارزیابی ناباروری یک رویکرد سیستماتیک دارد که سه محور اصلی را بررسی میکند: تخمکگذاری (با سابقهٔ قاعدگی منظم یا تستهای تخمکگذاری)، عامل مردانه (با آنالیز منی) و عامل لولهای/رحمی (با تصویربرداری). در این بیمار، دو محور اول تقریباً طبیعیاند: قاعدگی منظم است که تخمکگذاری منظم را مطرح میکند و آنالیز منی همسر نرمال است. نکتهٔ کلیدی، سابقهٔ حاملگی لولهای (خارجرحمی) درمانشده است که بهشدت احتمال آسیب و انسداد لولهٔ فالوپ را بالا میبرد؛ بنابراین عامل لولهای محتملترین علت ناباروری ثانویه است. تست انتخابی برای ارزیابی باز بودن لولهها، هیستروسالپنگوگرافی (HSG) است که یک روش رادیولوژیک با تزریق مادهٔ حاجب از سرویکس است و هم باز بودن لولهها و هم شکل حفرهٔ رحم را نشان میدهد. لاپاراسکوپی تشخیصی تهاجمیتر است…
questions.explanation_en: Infertility evaluation follows a systematic approach assessing three main axes: ovulation (by a history of regular menses or ovulation tests), the male factor (by semen analysis) and the tubal/uterine factor (by imaging). In this patient, the first two axes are essentially normal: menses are regular, suggesting regular ovulation, and the partner's semen analysis is normal. Main risk factors include obesity (high BMI), increased neck circumference, male sex and resistant hypertension. OSA is associated with increased risk of hypertension, cardiovascular disease, stroke and accidents. questions.explanation_en: Cluster headache is one of the most painful headache types and belongs to the trigeminal-autonomic cephalalgias. It is characterized by severe unilateral attacks of pain around the eye or temple that are short (15 minutes to 3 hours) and often recur at fixed times of day (especially at night) in clusters over weeks. Attacks are accompanied by ipsilateral autonomic features: lacrimation, eye redness, nasal congestion or rhinorrhea, ptosis and restlessness (unlike migraine, where the patient prefers to stay still). questions.explanation_en: Malignant hyperthermia is a life-threatening pharmacogenetic disorder that occurs in susceptible individuals after exposure to anesthetic triggers (volatile inhaled agents such as halothane, sevoflurane and isoflurane, and the muscle relaxant succinylcholine). Its mechanism is uncontrolled release of calcium from the muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum due to a defective ryanodine receptor, leading to severe sustained muscle contraction, hypermetabolism, a rapid rise in body temperature, muscle rigidity, tachycardia, acidosis and rhabdomyolysis. questions.explanation_fa: همیبالیسموس (hemiballismus) یک اختلال حرکتی هایپرکینتیک نادر است که با حرکات غیرارادی، ناگهانی، پرتابی و شدید (flinging) در یک سمت بدن مشخص میشود و عمدتاً عضلات پروگزیمال اندامها را درگیر میکند. علت کلاسیک آن، آسیب (اغلب سکتهٔ لاکونار) هستهٔ سابتالامیک (subthalamic nucleus) طرف مقابل است که در افراد مبتلا به دیابت و پرفشاری خون شایعتر است. پاتوفیزیولوژی آن، از دست رفتن مهار طبیعی گلوبوس پالیدوس توسط هستهٔ سابتالامیک و در نتیجه فعالیت بیشازحد مسیر حرکتی است. درمان بر کاهش انتقال دوپامینرژیک استوار است: تترابنازین (که دوپامین را از پایانههای عصبی تخلیه میکند) و آنتاگونیستهای گیرندهٔ دوپامین مانند هالوپریدول مؤثرند. برعکس، لوودوپا که دوپامین را افزایش میدهد، حرکات را تشدید میکند و ممنوع است. ب…
questions.explanation_en: Hemiballismus is a rare hyperkinetic movement disorder characterized by involuntary, sudden, flinging, violent movements on one side of the body, predominantly involving the proximal limb muscles. Its classic cause is damage (often a lacunar stroke) of the contralateral subthalamic nucleus, more common in people with diabetes and hypertension. Its pathophysiology is loss of the subthalamic nucleus's normal inhibition of the globus pallidus, resulting in excessive motor pathway activity. Treatment rests on reducing dopaminergic transmission: tetrabenazine (which depletes dopamine from nerve terminals) and dopamine receptor antagonists such as haloperidol are effective. questions.explanation_en: The RB51 vaccine is a live attenuated strain of Brucella abortus used for livestock (cattle) vaccination, and veterinarians and animal workers are at risk of accidental exposure (needlestick, splash to the eye/wound). A key, exam-favorite point is that the RB51 strain is intrinsically resistant to rifampin; therefore the standard brucellosis regimen (doxycycline + rifampin) is inappropriate here. This strain is also resistant to penicillins. The recommended regimen for post-exposure prophylaxis after an RB51 needlestick is a combination of doxycycline + cotrimoxazole (trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole) for about three weeks. questions.explanation_en: Toxoplasmosis is an infection caused by the parasite Toxoplasma gondii, with transmission routes including eating undercooked meat, contact with cat feces and congenital transmission. Clinical manifestations and the need for treatment depend entirely on the host's immune status. In an immunocompetent person, acquired infection is often asymptomatic or presents with mild, self-limited features such as painless cervical lymphadenopathy, mild fever, weakness and fatigue resembling mononucleosis; this form usually resolves spontaneously over weeks to months and needs no antiparasitic treatment. questions.question_fa: آ قای ۴۵ ساله مبتال به لوسمی حادAML که تحت شیمی درمانی قرار گرفته، دچار تب شده و در آزمایشCBC، نوتروپنی شدید دارد. علی رذم آنتی بیوتیک وسیع الطیف، تب بیمار پس از 7 روز همچنان ادامه دارد. در سی تری اسکن قفسه سینه، ندول ریوی با نمایHalo sign دیده می شود. در بیوپسی ندول، هایفای باریک دارای سپتا با زاویه ۴۵ درجه گزارش شده است. با توجه به محتمل ترین تشخیص، مناسب ترین درمان کدام است؟ - الف) آمفوتریسینB داکسی کوالت - ب) فلوکونازول - ج) وریکونازول ✅ - د) کاسپوفانژین
questions.question_en: A 45-year-old with acute AML on chemotherapy develops fever with severe neutropenia on CBC. Despite broad-spectrum antibiotics, fever persists after 7 days. Chest CT shows a pulmonary nodule with halo sign. Nodule biopsy shows thin septate hyphae branching at 45°. Given the most likely diagnosis, best treatment? - A) Amphotericin B deoxycholate - B) Fluconazole - C) Voriconazole ✅ - D) Caspofungin
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: آمفوتریسین B دئوکسیکولات جایگزین است اما به دلیل سمیت کلیوی و کارآیی کمتر، خط اول آسپرژیلوزیس تهاجمی نیست.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: فلوکونازول علیه آسپرژیلوس بیاثر است (پوشش کپک ندارد).

questions.explanation_en: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis is an aggressive, life-threatening fungal infection occurring mainly in patients with severe, prolonged neutropenia (such as AML patients on chemotherapy) and other severely immunosuppressed people. A suggestive clinical sign is fever refractory to broad-spectrum antibiotics in a neutropenic patient. Characteristic imaging findings include the halo sign (a nodule with a surrounding ground-glass halo indicating early hemorrhage) and, at later stages, the air-crescent sign. questions.question_fa: آقای ۳۰ سالهHIV مثبت باCD4=100 اخیرا با بیمار مبتال به سل ریوی اسمیر مثبرت، تمراس نزدیرک داشرته است. وی شکایت یا نشانه بالینی خاصی ندارد. در بررسی انجام شده، گرافی قفسه سینه طبیعی بوده و در تست توبرکولین، اندوراسیون به قطر کمتر از ۵ میلی متر گزارش شده است. مناسب ترین اقدام کدام است؟ - الف) تجویز ایزونیازید به مدت حداقل 6 ماه ✅ - ب) پایش عالئم بالینی تا 3 ماه بدون شروع دارو - ج) انجامIGRA و شروع ایزونیازید در صورت مثبت بودن آن - د) شروع ایزونیازید، تکرار تستPPD سه ماه بعد و قطع دارو در صورت منفی شدن آن
questions.question_en: A 30-year-old HIV-positive man with CD4 100 recently had close contact with a smear-positive pulmonary TB patient. He has no symptoms. CXR normal and tuberculin test induration <5 mm. Most appropriate action? - A) Give isoniazid for at least 6 months ✅ - B) Monitor symptoms for 3 months without starting medication - C) Do IGRA and start isoniazid if positive - D) Start isoniazid, repeat PPD in 3 months, stop if negative

options_why_fa: صحیح است؛ در فرد HIV مثبت با تماس نزدیک با سل فعال، صرفنظر از منفی بودن PPD (به دلیل آنرژی در ایمونوساپرس)، درمان عفونت نهفتهٔ سل (ایزونیازید ≥۶–۹ ماه) پس از رد سل فعال توصیه میشود؛ صحیح.

questions.explanation_en: Latent TB infection (LTBI) is a state in which a person is infected with Mycobacterium tuberculosis but has no active disease and is asymptomatic; its treatment prevents progression to active TB. In HIV-positive patients, the risk of LTBI progressing to active TB is very high, especially with a low CD4. The key point is that in an HIV-positive person with close contact with an active smear-positive pulmonary TB case, LTBI treatment should be started after ruling out active TB (with a chest X-ray and symptom assessment), regardless of the result of the tuberculin skin test (PPD) or IGRA. After 2 days fever resolves, pain and redness decrease but swelling increases. questions.explanation_en: Erysipelas is a superficial skin infection involving the upper dermis and superficial lymphatics, most commonly caused by group A beta-hemolytic streptococcus. Its clinical hallmark is a red, warm, painful lesion with a raised, sharply demarcated border (well separated from healthy skin), often involving the face or limbs and accompanied by fever and acute onset; this sharp border distinguishes it from ordinary cellulitis (which has an indistinct border). The treatment of choice is penicillin (or amoxicillin) because streptococcus is sensitive to it. questions.explanation_en: A lung abscess is a walled-off collection of pus in the lung parenchyma, often occurring after aspiration of oropharyngeal contents; its risk factors include a decreased level of consciousness (seizure, alcoholism, anesthesia), dysphagia and poor oral hygiene. Because of anatomy, the abscess often forms in dependent segments (the posterior segment of the upper lobe or the superior segment of the lower lobe, especially on the right). The microbial agents are usually polymicrobial and include oral anaerobes and microaerophilic streptococci. questions.explanation_en: Infections after animal bites or scratches (especially cats and dogs) are usually polymicrobial because of the animal's oral flora and human skin flora. Other agents include skin staphylococci and streptococci and anaerobes. questions.question_en: A 30-year-old woman with no underlying disease develops fever, headache, focal seizures and behavioral changes over 2 days. CSF: 50 cells (90% lymphocytes), RBC 40000, normal glucose and protein. Brain CT shows decreased signal in the left temporal lobe. Given the most likely diagnosis, best treatment? - A) IV acyclovir ✅ - B) Metronidazole + ceftriaxone - C) Dexamethasone + vancomycin + ceftriaxone - D) IV ganciclovir

questions.question_en: A 28-year-old man who recently traveled to Sistan-Baluchestan province develops periodic fevers, anemia and thrombocytopenia. Peripheral smear shows multiple rings in RBCs with banana-shaped gametocytes. Most appropriate treatment? - A) Pyrimethamine + quinine - B) Artesunate/lumefantrine ✅ - C) Primaquine + chloroquine - D) Doxycycline + mefloquine

questions.explanation_en: Malaria is a parasitic disease caused by Plasmodium transmitted by the bite of the Anopheles mosquito, and in Iran, Sistan and Baluchestan province is its main focus. Diagnosis and species identification are done by examining peripheral blood smears (thin and thick). The key morphologic point is that a banana- or crescent-shaped gametocyte is the specific hallmark of Plasmodium falciparum; other species have round gametocytes. Falciparum is the most dangerous species and can cause severe malaria (cerebral, renal failure, hypoglycemia, ARDS) and is associated with high parasitemia, anemia and thrombocytopenia. Diagnosis and species identification are done by examining peripheral blood smears (thin and thick). The key morphologic point is that a banana- or crescent-shaped gametocyte is the specific hallmark of Plasmodium falciparum; other species have round gametocytes. Falciparum is the most dangerous species and can cause severe malaria (cerebral, renal failure, hypoglycemia, ARDS) and is associated with high parasitemia, anemia and…

questions.question_en: A 60-year-old woman one week after hospital discharge develops mild fever, nausea, diarrhea and abdominal pain. No hypotension; clinically stable. Labs: WBC 12000, Cr 1.2. questions.explanation_en: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) is the leading cause of hospital-acquired and antibiotic-associated diarrhea, typically following broad-spectrum antibiotics (clindamycin, fluoroquinolones, cephalosporins). Diagnosis combines clinical features (watery diarrhea, fever, abdominal pain, leukocytosis) with a positive stool test (toxin/PCR/GDH). Per updated IDSA/SHEA guidance (2021), for an initial CDI episode—whether non-severe or severe—oral fidaxomicin or oral vancomycin are first-line, while oral metronidazole has been removed from first-line and is reserved only when neither is available (mild cases). Classic chest radiograph findings include cardiomegaly, upper-zone vascular redistribution (cephalization), peripheral basal Kerley B septal lines, peribronchial cuffing, pleural effusions, and in severe cases bat-wing alveolar opacities. A key discriminator is that, unlike pneumonic consolidation, edema and effusion usually lack an air bronchogram and the opacities may be somewhat asymmetric. questions.explanation_en: Diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis (DISH, Forestier disease) is a non-inflammatory ossifying process characterized by calcification and ossification of ligaments and entheses, especially the anterior longitudinal ligament of the spine, most often in older men and people with diabetes. Resnick's three diagnostic criteria are: (1) flowing ossification of the anterior longitudinal ligament along at least four contiguous vertebral bodies ('candle-wax' appearance); (2) relative preservation of intervertebral disc height without severe degenerative disc changes; and (3) absence of sacroiliac and apophyseal joint ankylosis (which separates it from ankylosing spondylitis). options_why_fa: صحیح است؛ کلسیفیکاسیون آمورف/ابریمانند متعدد در کبد میتواند نشانهٔ متاستاز کلسیفیه (مثلاً از آدنوکارسینوم موسینی کولون) باشد و احتمال بدخیمی را بیشتر مطرح میکند (پاسخ).

questions.explanation_fa: الگوی کلسیفیکاسیون در تصویربرداری (بهویژه CT) سرنخ مهمی برای افتراق ضایعات خوشخیم از بدخیم است. کلسیفیکاسیونهای منظم، حلقوی، پاپکورنی یا لبهای معمولاً به نفع فرایند خوشخیم (مثل فیبروم رحمی، گرانولوم، هامارتوم) هستند، در حالی که کلسیفیکاسیون بیشکل (amorphous)، ابریمانند (cloudlike)، پراکنده یا نامنظم میتواند نشانهٔ بدخیمی باشد. در کبد، کلسیفیکاسیونهای متعدد و بیشکل بیشتر مطرحکنندهٔ متاستازهای کلسیفیه (بهویژه از آدنوکارسینوم موسینی کولورکتال، تخمدان یا معده) یا تومورهای اولیهٔ کلسیفیه هستند و احتمال بدخیمی را بالا میبرند. در مقابل، کلسیفیکاسیون فوکال در رحم معمولاً میوم کلسیفیه (خوشخیم)، کلسیفیکاسیون متعدد پانکراس نشانهٔ پانکراتیت مزمن کلسیفیک، و کلسیفیکاسیون منتشر دوطرفهٔ کلیهها نفروکلسینوز…
questions.explanation_en: The pattern of calcification on imaging (especially CT) is an important clue for distinguishing benign from malignant lesions. Regular, ring-like, popcorn, or rim calcifications usually favor a benign process (e.g., uterine fibroid, granuloma, hamartoma), whereas amorphous, cloudlike, scattered, or irregular calcification can signal malignancy. In the liver, multiple amorphous calcifications more often indicate calcified metastases (especially from mucinous colorectal, ovarian, or gastric adenocarcinoma) or calcifying primary tumors, raising the probability of malignancy.
